name: dsh-model-usage-widget
description: Per-provider LLM usage widget for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar footer: reads the model-config provider list (llm-deepseek + llm-pi-ai settings namespaces), resolves API keys through the credentials seam, shows DeepSeek balance, MiniMax coding-plan windows, and Volcengine Ark usage via the local arkcli CLI (with a POST ark-login route spawning arkcli auth login volc-sso). Static host routes + client bundle — no dynamic runner, no conversation wake.
